scope: All per-method fresh process overhead included. Parent orchestration, preflight, resume smoke, cost pilot and readout reported separately. Installation and development excluded.
preliminary_timing_policy: Superseded native-only comparisons and old pilots are preserved but never pooled with final controls.
initial_partial_packaging_scope: Initial copy/ledger work only; this clock ended before archives and final hash manifests. It is not total publication time.
timing_nesting: Main loop and worker clocks are nested in main external wall. Final preflight/quick/pilot are nested in the repair interval. Reports/audits/export are separately measured. Do not sum nested clocks. Publication and development time are excluded from method runtime comparisons.
